summary: Feed s179_triple is degraded with 3 high-severity faults: 86% encrypted traffic exceeds IDS tolerance (60%), required VLAN 20 missing with 36% untagged, and 44% of TCP sessions are one-way. IDS requires both directions and full payload for stateful inspection.

findings.root_cause: 86% of bytes are encrypted (TLS) vs 60% IDS tolerance. Traffic is not being decrypted before the IDS - likely no SSL visibility/decryption appliance in the packet broker path or decryption policy not enabled for this feed.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload for signature and anomaly detection; encrypted payloads are opaque so IDS cannot inspect content, allowing threats inside TLS to bypass detection and inflating false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: IDS cannot analyze encrypted payloads; selective decryption before the IDS restores visibility while respecting privacy/policy, bringing encrypted share below 60% threshold.

findings.root_cause: Required VLAN 20 not seen and 36% of packets are untagged. Packet broker is likely stripping 802.1Q tags on ingress/egress, or SPAN/trunk is not forwarding VLAN 20, or VLAN filter is dropping it before the IDS port.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS is blind to VLAN 20 segment which it is required to monitor; untagged packets lose tenant/segment context, breaking VLAN-aware policies and detection coverage for that network zone.

recommended_fix.why: Restore and preserve VLAN tags end-to-end from TAP/SPAN through packet broker to IDS so required VLAN 20 is delivered and segmentation context is retained.

findings.root_cause: 44% of TCP sessions (48/109) show only one direction, well above 10% threshold. Indicates asymmetric routing with capture on only one path, or packet broker not aggregating both directions to the same IDS port, or SPAN missing the return path.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires both directions for TCP reassembly and stateful inspection; one-way traffic breaks stream reconstruction, prevents detection of handshakes, exploits, and response-based signatures, severely reducing detection accuracy.

recommended_fix.why: Aggregate both directions of each flow to the same IDS tool port to restore full bidirectional sessions needed for stateful IDS analysis.
